svg.title: Meadow Loop layout
svg.text: MEADOW LOOP · Meadow · 64x40 tiles · road 3 tiles wide
Lap 176 tiles = 22,555 px · about 27 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 10.2 tiles · bridge crossing at 75°
Dashed white = racing line. Pink = mid-lap checkpoint. Pale blue on the road = ice. Orange = boost pad.
Kerbs wherever the bend is tight. Map edge is a wall. One faint square = one 128 px tile.
